server.headline: Your vehicle on the map, live.
server.title: Where is your platform?
server.body: Type the address you use to open OpenGPS on the web.
server.label: Address
server.invalid: Type a valid address, like app.opengps.dev.
server.unreachable: Couldn't connect to that address. Check that it's spelled right and that the platform is running.
server.notPlatform: There's no OpenGPS platform at that address.
server.incompatible: This app doesn't work with that platform's version. Update the app or the platform.

signIn.title: Sign in to your account
signIn.resentOk: Done, we sent it again. It may take a minute; check your spam folder too.
signIn.resendFailed: We couldn't resend it. Try again in a moment.

consent.title: We updated the terms
consent.body: To keep using {{app}}, read and accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.

suspended.title: This account is suspended
suspended.body: The account {{name}} can't be used for now. If you think this is a mistake, write to us and we'll look into it.

errors.network: Couldn't complete the action. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server: Couldn't reach the server. Check your internet connection.

auth.wrongCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
auth.emailNotVerified: You haven't confirmed your email yet. We just sent you the link again.
auth.banned: This account is suspended. Write to us if you think it's a mistake.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
auth.sessionOld: For your safety, sign in again and do it right away.

map.noPosition: None of your vehicles has a position yet.

empty.title: No vehicles yet
empty.body: Add your GPS on the web and it will show up here and on the map.

noDevice.title: No GPS connected
noDevice.body: This vehicle has no device. Connect one on the web to see it on the map.

pending.title: Waiting for the first signal
pending.body: Set up the device so it reports to the platform.

parked.title: Parked mode
parked.on: Turned on {{since}}. Alerts you if it moves from here.
parked.off: Alerts you if the vehicle moves from where it is.

share.title: Share location
share.intro: Create a link so someone without an account can see where {{name}} is. It stops working when it expires, or when you revoke it.
share.created: Link created. Send it now: for security it will not be shown again.
share.warning: Anyone with this link will see the live location. Send it only to whoever should see it.
share.none: None. No one outside can see this vehicle.

photo.noPermission: To take the photo, allow camera access in Settings.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter your account's email and we'll send you a link to create a new one.
forgot.sent: If that email has an account, the link is on its way. It expires in 1 hour and opens on the web.

feed.empty: No events yet. They'll show up when a vehicle enters or leaves a geofence or something needs your attention.

eventNote.overrev: Reached {{rpm}} rpm; the limit is {{limit}} rpm
eventNote.batteryLow: At {{volts}} V; the minimum is {{limit}} V
eventNote.fuelTheft: {{liters}} L left the tank with the engine off
eventNote.fuelDrain: {{liters}} L left the tank while stopped
eventNote.drivingDaily: Has been at the wheel for {{time}} this shift; the maximum is {{max}}
eventNote.drivingDailyDriver: {{driver}} has been at the wheel for {{time}} this shift; the maximum is {{max}}
eventNote.drivingNonstop: Has been at the wheel for {{time}} without a break; the maximum is {{max}}
eventNote.drivingNonstopDriver: {{driver}} has been at the wheel for {{time}} without a break; the maximum is {{max}}
eventNote.speeding: Was going {{speed}} km/h; the limit is {{limit}} km/h
eventNote.unauthorizedMovement: Moved {{meters}} m from where it was parked
eventNote.tow: Moving at {{speed}} km/h with the engine off

summary.title: Summary
summary.eventsNote: alerts and notices of the last day

noData.title: No movement in this period
noData.lead: The device sent no positions on these dates. Try another period.

range.endBeforeStart: The end date must be after the start date.
range.tooLong: The period can't be longer than {{days}} days.

trips.empty: No trips in this period. The vehicle didn't move.

stops.empty: No stops longer than three minutes in this period.

export.failed: The file couldn't be downloaded. Check the connection and try again.

format.xlsx: Excel: totals, trips, stops and positions
format.pdf: PDF: report with the route, trips and stops
format.gpx: GPX: for navigation devices and other GPS apps

lock.unsupported: This GPS device doesn't support remote locking.
lock.supportUnknown: Once the device reports, we'll know whether it supports remote locking.

note.never: No lock command has ever been sent to this vehicle.
note.lockSent: The command went out {{when}}; the device doesn't report whether it applied it.
note.unlockConfirmed: The device confirmed it restored the engine {{when}}.
note.unlockSent: The unlock command went out {{when}}; the device doesn't report whether it applied it.

pending.expires: {{note}}. If it can't be sent, it expires in {{minutes}} min.
pending.sent: Waiting for the device to confirm it applied it.

lastFailed.lock: The last lock command didn't complete: {{status}}.
lastFailed.lockNote: The last lock command didn't complete: {{status}} ({{note}}).
lastFailed.unlock: The last unlock command didn't complete: {{status}}.
lastFailed.unlockNote: The last unlock command didn't complete: {{status}} ({{note}}).

recovery.title: Recovery mode
recovery.active: Turned on {{since}}. The link for the authorities is still valid.
recovery.inactive: If it was stolen: more frequent reports and a link for the police.
recovery.linkBody: This link shows live where {{name}} is, no account needed. Give it to the police or to whoever will recover it. It's valid for 72 hours, or until you turn off recovery mode.
recovery.copyNow: Send it now: for security it won't be shown again. The case was opened in Incidents.
recovery.offBody: The link for the authorities will stop working and the device will go back to its normal reporting rate.

dialog.lockBody: You're about to cut off the engine of {{name}}. For safety, the command only goes out when the vehicle is under {{speed}} km/h: a moving vehicle's engine is never cut.
dialog.unlockBody: You're about to restore the engine of {{name}}.
dialog.safeNow: The vehicle is stopped or moving slowly: the command will be sent right away.
dialog.notSafe: It isn't safe to cut off the engine now. The command will wait and go out on its own as soon as the vehicle drops below {{speed}} km/h. If that doesn't happen within {{minutes}} minutes, it's cancelled.

fuel.title: Fuel
fuel.noTank: Set up the tank on the web to see the level, consumption and efficiency.
fuel.noLevel: The device hasn't sent the level in the last 7 days.
fuel.noSensor: No level sensor: consumption is estimated from the expected rate.

wizard.name: Vehicle name
wizard.needName: Give it a name to recognize it on the map.
wizard.find: Brand or model of your GPS
wizard.findPlaceholder: Type to search: FMC920, ST-901, GT06N…
wizard.needModel: Choose the brand or the model of your GPS.
wizard.empty: We did not find that model. Type the brand and choose “another model” of it.
wizard.imeiHint: 15 digits. It's on the device label or its box.
wizard.idHint: It's on the device label. Usually 10 to 12 digits long.
wizard.badId: Type the {{idLabel}} exactly as it appears on the device: letters and numbers only, no spaces.
wizard.addFailed: Couldn't add the GPS. Try again.
wizard.commandsNote: These are the usual {{brand}} commands. If your model uses others, look in its manual for how to change the server and port.

waiting.title: Waiting for the first signal…
waiting.updates: This screen updates on its own when it reports.
waiting.updatesMinutes: This screen updates on its own when it reports; you have {{n}} min to connect it.

wizard.firstSignal: We received its first signal. From now on you'll see it move on the map.
wizard.expired: Time ran out without a signal from this GPS, so it was released. Check the setup and add it again.

profile.title: Your details
profile.name: Your name
profile.phoneNote: With its country code, for example +50499887766. To get by SMS the notifications that include you.
profile.badName: Enter your name, at least 2 letters long.
profile.badPhone: Enter the phone number with its country code, for example +50499887766.

password.title: Password
password.others: Sign out on your other devices
password.changedOthers: Done: your password changed and you are signed out on your other devices.
password.noneLead: You sign in with another service or a passkey, so you have no password. If you want one, we'll email you a link to create it.
password.sent: We sent the link to {{email}}. Open it to create your password.

deleteAccount.title: Delete my account
deleteAccount.intro: Your user {{email}} will be deleted and, with it, the accounts you own:
deleteAccount.vehicles: Their vehicles, GPS devices and all trip history.
deleteAccount.people: Their groups, invited users and activity log.
deleteAccount.final: The devices will stop reporting to the platform. This can't be undone.
deleteAccount.noPassword: You sign in with another service and have no password. If your session is not recent, sign in again and delete it right away.

editVehicle.title: Edit vehicle
editVehicle.name: Name
editVehicle.unplugBody: The device {{id}} will stop reporting to your account and this vehicle's trip history will be deleted. You can connect another GPS later.
editVehicle.unplugNote: If you remove it, it stops reporting to your account and this vehicle's trip history is deleted.
editVehicle.noGps: This vehicle has no GPS connected. Add one with the + button in Vehicles.

driver.sinceKey: Started driving {{when}} · identified with their key.
driver.noneNote: What it drives won't count for any driver.
driver.noDrivers: Add your drivers on the web, in Drivers, to assign them.
driver.unknownKeyBody: The device read the key {{key}} {{when}}, and it doesn't belong to any driver. Add it on the web, in Drivers.

diag.title: Engine diagnostics
diag.noData: This device hasn't sent engine data yet.
diag.nowEmpty: This device hasn't sent vehicle data in the last seven days. Reading it takes a device with an OBD reader or connected to the vehicle's network (CAN).
diag.nowNote: Only what this device reads from the vehicle shows up. Each value shows its latest reading.
diag.faultsEmpty: This vehicle hasn't reported fault codes. They show up here, with their explanation, when the device reads them from the vehicle's computer.
diag.faultsNone: None: the vehicle reports no faults now.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.emptyOpen: No open incidents. A panic button, a tow, device tampering or a parked vehicle that moves shows up here.
incidents.emptyAll: There haven't been any incidents yet.
incidents.reportLead: For what the GPS device doesn't report on its own: a theft someone tells you about by phone, a crash, a vehicle being held.
incidents.notePlaceholder: What was done, who was contacted…
incidents.closeLead: A closed incident no longer accepts notes or evidence. If something happens to the vehicle again, a new one is opened.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.lead: Free, no card needed. Then add your GPS device in two minutes.
signUp.name: Your name
signUp.mustAccept: To create your account you need to accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.
signUp.closed: Sign-up for new accounts is closed. Only people who received an invitation by email can sign up.
signUp.acceptLabel: I accept the terms of use and the privacy policy
signUp.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in here

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.sentAfter: . If the account is new, open it to confirm it and then sign in here with your email and password; if you already had one with that email, it tells you how to sign in.
checkEmail.slow: It may take a minute. Check your spam folder too.

services.notLinked: There is already an account with that email, but the service does not confirm it is yours. Sign in with your password.
services.noEmail: The service did not share your email. Allow it when signing in, or use another one.
services.cancelled: You cancelled signing in with the service.
services.failed: Could not sign in with that service. Try again.
services.termsBefore: If you do not have an account yet, it is created when you continue. By doing so you accept the

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will no longer sign you in here. Delete it from your device or keychain too.
passkeys.deleteBody_android: “{{name}}” will no longer sign you in here. Delete it from your device or Google Password Manager too.
passkeys.none: You have no passkeys yet. Create one to sign in with Face ID, without a password.
passkeys.none_android: You have no passkeys yet. Create one to sign in with your fingerprint or screen lock, without a password.
passkeys.noneHere: You have no passkeys yet. Create them in your profile, on the web.

passkey.created: Passkey created. Next time, sign in with “Sign in with a passkey”.
passkey.failed: The passkey could not be created. Try again.
